description.value: Pier Bistro Restaurant sits at the end of Beacon Avenue on Sidney's pier, beside the Fish Market, offering panoramic harbour views from a casual waterfront setting. The menu is built around BC coastal seafood staples — fish and chips in three species, house crab cakes, clam chowder, and local mussels — alongside burgers, sandwiches, and salads. For a touring cyclist finishing a ride through the Saanich Peninsula, it is a classic end-of-the-road lunch or dinner spot with the ocean right outside.
